auth_method: API key via query parameter (?y=), optional ?u=<username> on user-scoped calls
notes: RA API usage in this plugin is read-only (GET only) — no write/create/update/delete model. Fabrication and Mosaic subcategories are pure local geometry components with no HTTP calls at all; only Ingest talks to the network. Gate 2 resolutions: (1) Mosaic keeps 3 distinct components (Lego Stud Plate / Perler Bead Grid / LED Matrix Mapper) — different fabrication outputs (watertight stud meshes, pegboard layouts with part counts, serpentine wiring code arrays); shared grid-walk math lives in an internal helper (see PixelGridBuilders.cs / a shared MosaicHelpers routine), each keeps its own canvas icon. (2) Ingest keeps Local Sprite Loader and Sprite Sheet Splitter decoupled — single-frame artwork only needs the loader, multi-frame atlases need both. (3) The standalone Auth/key-check component was removed; RA Console (06. Presets) now takes Token and its GetConsoleIDs call serves as both connectivity verification and value-list populator. (4) All subcategory ribbon-tab names use zero-padded two-digit numeric prefixes (01.-07.) so PluginUtilities.TabName sorts correctly on the Grasshopper ribbon — unpadded prefixes (1., 2., ... 10.) sort lexicographically wrong once a build reaches double digits, the exact issue seen on the PokeData dogfood run.
ribbon_tab_numbering: zero-padded two-digit (01, 02, ... 07) — never bare single-digit prefixes

components.note: Accepts rows of pixel data (a hand-authored, spreadsheet-sourced, or sprite-derived tabular grid) in either of two forms and produces the single shared Pixel Grid JSON contract consumed by every Fabrication/Mosaic component below.
components.implementation_note: Revised per Gate 6 contract clarification: Rows is now a generic (Colour or Text) tree accepting EITHER (a) a DataTree where each branch {y} holds multiple Colour/hex items (one per cell), OR (b) a flat list with one comma-separated hex string per row (e.g. "#FF0000, #00FF00, #0000FF"). Added Pitch/Thickness inputs (informational metadata only). Output schema changed from {rows,cols,cells} to {bounds,pitch,thickness,palette,indices} — palette is deduplicated in first-seen order, indices reference it, -1 marks a void/transparent cell.
